qa_issues: Units for 'Resource Efficiency' values are missing, especially for the second column of numbers (e.g., 45, 22, 208)
The 'Monthly Bookings Trend' y-axis label 'Bookings Count' is rotated 90 degrees but difficult to read against the dark background. Might be a deliberate aesthetic, but slightly hampers readability.

The placement of the 'Hull-03' tooltip/overlay on the boat image feels a little crude and generic, not fully integrated into the design. Also, 'Ready for Launch' is difficult to read due to font size and color contrast against the boat hull.
The main image is beautiful but doesn't feel integrated into the UI (e.g. it's a static image, not a live feed of the selected 'Haul Out' or 'Yard Slip 4').
The overall layout feels a bit flat in places, relying heavily on subtle shadows for depth rather than more pronounced visual separation.
Some interactive elements (e.g., booking flow buttons) are quite small and could benefit from more generous sizing and spacing for better tap/click targets.
The 'Optimize Travel Lift 2' card is good, but the call-to-action buttons below it are very small and visually weak.
"Available" and "Occupied" text on Berth Map Overview appear inconsistent, possibly due to font smoothing or rendering issues.
Small text elements for 'efficiency gain' and the tags below it are quite small and might be hard to read for some users.
The 'View' button next to Falmouth Marina, while functional, is a bit generic and could be more visually integrated or branded.
